shared_elements: upright slab surface covered with carved low-relief signs
script-like glyph/sign groups arranged in ordered rows or columns
small anthropomorphic/head motifs within the sign field
horizontal division of the field into bands or registers
justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs densely covered with schematic low-relief sign groups arranged in ordered rows/columns, and both include small human-headed or anthropomorphic elements within that sign field, but this is a very generic correspondence. A is entirely a grid of compact rounded glyph blocks with no scenic figures, while B is dominated by two registers of full-length standing figures facing one another around offerings, with signs merely filling the spaces above them — a scene versus a pure text panel.
